source_manifest.dataset: NG14 P37 native FE case results

shift_mapping.configuration_ids: Published IDs use the UI shift-list number; source_configuration preserves the original FE ID.

source_manifest.reason_sanitization: The HOLD traceback was replaced with a concise explanation; local absolute paths were excluded.
source_manifest.archive_scope: This web dataset is the full case-metrics table, not the 33.8 GB raw research archive.
source_manifest.encoding: UTF-8 CSV; gzip-compressed and base64-encoded in ordered text parts for GitHub contents transport

AB_SHIFT.text: HOLD before Analyze: local contact repair stopped because MESH_META.json already existed; the evidence-overwrite guard prevented replacing it. No FE case results were produced for this model.

notes: P37, boundary 1.0 m; viewer field and element order follow NG13/P36 schema.
Native Rhino 7 / Karamba data reused from the local NG14 run; exporter does not call Analyze.
Published shift is the web shift list; source_shift_index is one less and source_configuration is retained.
Stress is MPa; geometry and nodal translations are m. Viewer reports deformation magnitude in mm.

Shell display reduces native principal stress on both faces to max absolute value per triangular face. Beam display reduces 17 native stations to max absolute normal stress per beam element, matching P36 viewer semantics.
HOLD and missing native archives remain explicit; no contours are synthesized from CSV maxima.
Reviewed does not establish material capacity or structural safety.
